name: Top Company Priority Projects
query:
SELECT
    p.project_name as "Project Name",
    p.name as "Project ID:Link/Project:120",
    p.custom_company_priority as "Priority Score",
    (SELECT count(*) FROM `tabTask` t WHERE t.project = p.name) as "Total Tasks",
    (SELECT count(*) FROM `tabTask` t WHERE t.project = p.name AND t.status = 'Completed') as "Completed Tasks",
    (SELECT count(*) FROM `tabTask` t WHERE t.project = p.name AND t.exp_end_date < CURDATE() AND t.status != 'Completed') as "Overdue Tasks"
FROM
    `tabProject` p
WHERE
    p.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
    AND p.custom_company_priority IS NOT NULL
    AND p.custom_company_priority != ''
    AND CAST(p.custom_company_priority AS UNSIGNED) > 0
ORDER BY
    CAST(p.custom_company_priority AS UNSIGNED) ASC
LIMIT 10
